title: Start here — v0.79 GitHub full source versus v0.91 SQLite development candidate
summary: The GitHub complete versioned NoSQLServer source directory remains packages/nosqlserver_v0.79/. A separately delivered complete v0.91 ZIP adds explicit opt-in SQLite read/write, WAL-coherent SQLite backup snapshots, and v0.91 whole-table snapshot validation under BEGIN IMMEDIATE for single-table UPDATE/DELETE. PR #20 merged only a v0.90-to-v0.91 patch intake; that does NOT bring the complete executable v0.91 package into GitHub, nor establish production certification. Older FILE/Object/JSON/native SQLite read-only/GeoPackage/federated semantics remain.
invariants: Do not restart development from the old v0.13 interoperability handoff.
The project name does not mean the current engine is a simple document store.
Rows/scalars/parser nodes remain lightweight; only long-lived service/runtime objects use AlchemyObject.
SECURE_READY is host-configured and is never implied by STANDARD adoption.
Treat v0.79 as complete checked-in GitHub source, and v0.91 as qualified local candidate; do not claim complete GitHub sync.
SQLite writable is opt-in; never silently mutate GeoPackage or legacy native-read-only engine.

provenance.claim: Exact candidate design and qualification boundary.
